messages:
Sam F: Heads-up — we're thinking of adding an optional `trace_id` field to GenerationResponse proto to help routing logs. Quick compatibility Q: is adding an optional string field safe for all languages/SDKs? Anyone seen clients choke on unknown fields?
Elaine: Should be safe — protobuf's forwards/backwards compatible if field numbers unused. But need to ensure we don't change existing tags. :+1:
Chris: Only caveat: some older JSON->proto mappers that rely on exact schemas can break. Which SDKs parse proto JSON vs binary?
Tara: JS SDK deserializes via binary for now, but our REST layer does `proto3` JSON for debug endpoints.
Sam F: Right — REST debug returns path `/v1/debug/generate` with JSON. Concern is if we add `trace_id` we might break strict validators in client-side types.
Jorge: Suggest adding as `optional string trace_id = 520;` — pick a high tag. Also bump server to emit only when present.
Chris: Agree. Also need to update OpenAPI schema for the REST shape so generated TypeScript types don't flag missing fields. We can mark it optional there.
Sam F: Plan: add proto + OpenAPI optional; deploy server that does not emit until next release; then toggle in a canary. Timeline: proto change + tests this week, canary early next week, wide release after 2 days.
Tara: Tests: add e2e that simulates older clients ignoring unknown fields, and a negative test for strict JSON validators. I'll add CI job.
Elaine: Also add migration note in CHANGELOG and cherrypick to Dedicated/private release notes; for Private customers we should email early.
Sam F: For SDKs: @Chris can you add compatibility lint in the JS/TS generator to accept unknown keys? If not, we'll bump major for that SDK.
Chris: I can add a permissive parse option, but won't change major. Will open PR to generator tomorrow.
dev-bot: deploy-check: proto-test-suite passed on main-ci-014
Jorge: One more thing — new enum values are not safe (non-breaking only if unknown enum values map to UNRECOGNIZED on some languages). Don't add enum members.
Sam F: Good call. We'll avoid enums and use string typed union in REST only.
Tara: :+1: I'll add an integration test that runs the SDK generator and typecheck.
Sam F: Sounds good. Who owns the rollout comms for private customers? @Elaine?
Elaine: I can draft a short note and coordinate with CS. ETA: Fri.
Sam F: Great — will queue the PR. If anyone has objections, speak now or file a follow-up. Thanks!
